column5: the objc_msgSend cast passes -getCharacters:range:'s NSRange as two NSUInteger arguments; arm64 passes both forms in the same two registers, wasm32 passes the structure indirectly, so call_indirect traps on the mismatched type and no supplied library can change the cast

objc4 supports tagged pointer objects only with 64-bit pointers and the native encoding stores the length in bits 50 and up; on wasm32 the value truncates to an invalid object pointer, so the port answers the native function's own results for the empty string and for a string it cannot tag (NULL)
